swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP62200WU-7 uses TSOT-23-6 (6-pin, TSOT26) while TPS54331DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Soldering TPS54331DR onto a AP62200WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
HIGH RECTIFICATION DIFFERENCE: TPS54331DR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62200WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs TPS54331DR: 6.8 µH p.16); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62200WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs TPS54331DR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62200WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54331DR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 40% (AP62200WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs TPS54331DR: 116.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency is 750 kHz (p.5) vs 570 kHz (p.6), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), and Iq is 135 µA (p.5) vs 110 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 70 vs 116.3 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
